verdict.rationale: Homebrew's documented project-dependency mechanism is the Brewfile manifest. `brew bundle check` only reports whether the installed system satisfies the Brewfile, which compares the manifest to installed state, not to a lockfile. The evidence shows no lockfile and no frozen or immutable mode that fails an install on a manifest/lockfile mismatch, so this is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can enforce a frozen/immutable lockfile mode that fails the install when the manifest and lockfile disagree
